notes: SOURCE_POLICY: HOUSE_PHYSICAL_TOPOLOGY — NEUTRAL ANALYSIS V2. Canonical physical mapping: software FRONT=EAST/AVANT, REAR=WEST/ARRIERE, RIGHT=NORTH, LEFT=SOUTH. No geometry from historical scenes 004/005/006/007/008 was reused. USER_CONFIRMED and REPRESENTATION_CHOICE are intentionally separated in evidence. Total height, floor heights, roof angle, unmeasured opening sizes/positions, terrain amplitude, chimney placement, platform extents and stair rise/run are UNKNOWN in real-house truth; any numeric values for them are REPRESENTATION_CHOICE only. LAVOIR_REPRESENTATION_LIMITATION: lavoir is USER_CONFIRMED autonomous 1.78 x 1.20 m, distinct from house/stair/concrete platform/wood terrace; ArchitecturalScene v0.2 platform primitive requires host_volume_id, so it is intentionally omitted geometrically rather than falsely connected. PARAPET_REPRESENTATION_LIMITATION — masonry parapets along both stair flights are PHOTO-supported, but ArchitecturalScene v0.2 partial_wall_segments require horizontal baselines; NEUTRAL-001 therefore does not encode false sloped partial-wall geometry.
